value.rationale: The fully periodic 5-by-6 hard-square grid is the first coprime-sided adjacent-width case after the known 5-by-5 exact homotopy. The graph is a distinguished 30-vertex four-regular circulant as well as a canonical toric grid. Its complete sphere homotopy type is not implied by Jonsson’s known reduced Euler -1 and determines every integral homology group and absence of torsion; this is a natural topological boundary case, not an arbitrary parameter substitution.
